--We need to Use a WITH() function to create a temporary table for our SELECT statement 
--We will also use the UNION function to unify the results of all created temporary table
--We need to build 3 SELECT statement for CRM customer since we are sourcing the AccountNumber, AccountType, AccountSolID in different tables

WITH CTE as (       --> WITH CTE AS(SELECT STATEMENT) meaning we are building a temporary table that we can query later on. The name of the table would be CTE
    
    
--This SELECT statement contains the records of CRM Customers--
--This SELECT statement contains the AccountNumber, AccountType and AccountSolId of DEP--
SELECT
    [Group],
    BASE_SCORE as BaseScore,
    convert(varchar,b.orgkey) as CifId,
    b.name as CustomerName,
    convert(varchar(20),b.cust_dob,101) as DateOfBirth,
    b.MAIDENNAMEOFMOTHER as MothersMaidenName,
    b.GENERALTAXID as TaxIdentificationNumber,
    concat(c.address_line1, ' ', c.address_line2) as AddressLine1AndAddressLine2,
    concat(d.description , ' ', e.description) as CityAndProvince,
    convert(varchar(20),b.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE,101) as CifCreationDate,
    x.foracid as AccountNumber, -->  DEP
    x.schm_type as AccountType, --> DEP
    x.SOL_ID as AccountSolId, --> DEP
    CASE WHEN x.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and x.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= GETDATE() and x.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed' 
     WHEN x.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and x.SCHM_TYPE in ('SBA','CAA') THEN y.ACCT_STATUS 
     WHEN x.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and x.ACCT_CLS_DATE > GETDATE() and x.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA') THEN y.ACCT_STATUS 
     WHEN x.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and x.ACCT_CLS_DATE > GETDATE() and x.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN t.ACCT_STATUS 
     WHEN x.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and x.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN t.ACCT_STATUS 
     WHEN s.PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' and s.PAYOFF_DATE <= GETDATE() and x.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Closed' 
     WHEN s.PAYOFF_FLG = 'N' and x.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Active' 
     WHEN s.PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' and s.PAYOFF_DATE > GETDATE() and x.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Active' END as AccountStatus,
    convert(varchar(20),x.ACCT_OPN_DATE,101) as AccountOpeningDate,
    RIB_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as OnlineBankingIndicator,
    MBK_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as MobileBankingIndicator,
    ATM_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as LinkedCardIndicator
    
    from syn.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults a
        left join busc.crm_accounts b on replace(convert(varchar,a.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR),'CBC_CRM_','') = convert(varchar,b.accountid) ---> To connect busc.crm_accounts to get Orgkey(CifId), Name(CustomerName), Cust_DOB(DateOfBirth), MaidennameOfMother(MothersMaidenName), TIN(TaxIdentificationNumber), Cif Creation Date(CifCreationDate)
        left join busc.crm_address c on b.orgkey = convert(varchar,c.orgkey)      ---> Connection to get ADDRESS1 & ADDRESS2 (AddressLine1AndAddressLine2)
        left join busc.crm_categories d on d.value = c.City and d.categorytype = 'City' ---> Lookup to get the CITY (CityAndProvince)
        left join busc.crm_categories e on b.state = e.value and e.categorytype = 'State' ---> Lookup to get the STATE (CityAndProvince)
        left join busc.dep_accountrelationship z on z.cust_id = b.core_cust_id --> Connection to busc.dep_accountrelationship table
        left join busc.dep_generalaccountmaster x on x.acid = z.acid  --> Connection to busc.dep_generalaccountmaster to get busc.dep_gam foracid(AccountNumber),  SCHM_TYPE (AccountType), SOL_ID(AccountSolId)
        left join busc.dep_casamaster y on y.acid = x.acid --> Connection for AccountStatus
        left join busc.dep_tdmaster t on t.acid = x.acid  --> Connection for AccountStatus
        left join busc.lns_laacctmast s on s.acid = x.acid  --> Connection for AccountStatus
        where accountid_cust_nbr LIKE 'CBC_CRM%'
        -->isLatest  = 1 (Latest data for busc)
        and b.isLatest = 1 
        and c.isLatest = 1
        and d.isLatest = 1
        and e.isLatest = 1
        and z.isLatest = 1
        and x.isLatest = 1
--        and y.isLatest = 1
--        and t.isLatest = 1
--        and s.isLatest = 1

UNION --> Unifying all result of all field including the AccountNumber, AccountType and AccountSolId of DEP and LNS except duplicates


--This SELECT statement contains the AccountNumber, AccountType and AccountSolId of LNS--
select
    [Group],
    BASE_SCORE as BaseScore,
    convert(varchar,b.orgkey) as CifId,
    b.name as CustomerName,
    convert(varchar(20),b.cust_dob,101) as DateOfBirth,
    b.MAIDENNAMEOFMOTHER as MothersMaidenName,
    b.GENERALTAXID as TaxIdentificationNumber,
    concat(c.address_line1, ' ', c.address_line2) as AddressLine1AndAddressLine2,
    concat(d.description , ' ', e.description) as CityAndProvince,
    convert(varchar(20),b.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE,101) as CifCreationDate,
    n.foracid as AccountNumber, --LNS
    n.schm_type as AccountType, --LNS
    n.SOL_id as AccountSolid, -- LNS
    CASE WHEN n.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and n.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= GETDATE() and n.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed' 
     WHEN n.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and n.SCHM_TYPE IN ('SBA','CAA') THEN z.ACCT_STATUS 
     WHEN n.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and n.ACCT_CLS_DATE > GETDATE() and n.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA') THEN z.ACCT_STATUS 
     WHEN n.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and n.ACCT_CLS_DATE > GETDATE() and n.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN x.ACCT_STATUS 
     WHEN n.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and n.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN x.ACCT_STATUS 
     WHEN f.PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' and f.PAYOFF_DATE <= GETDATE() and n.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Closed'
     WHEN f.PAYOFF_FLG = 'N' and n.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA', 'CLA') THEN 'Active'
     WHEN f.PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' and f.PAYOFF_DATE > GETDATE() and n.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Active' END as AccountStatus,
    convert(varchar(20),n.ACCT_OPN_DATE,101) as AccountOpeningDate,
    RIB_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as OnlineBankingIndicator,
    MBK_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as MobileBankingIndicator,
    ATM_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as LinkedCardIndicator

    from syn.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults a
        left join busc.crm_accounts b on replace(convert(varchar,a.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR),'CBC_CRM_','') = convert(varchar,b.accountid)  ---> To connect busc.crm_accounts to get Orgkey(CifId), Name(CustomerName), Cust_DOB(DateOfBirth), MaidennameOfMother(MothersMaidenName), TIN(TaxIdentificationNumber), Cif Creation Date(CifCreationDate)
        left join busc.crm_address c on b.orgkey = convert(varchar,c.orgkey) ---> Connection to get ADDRESS1 & ADDRESS2 (AddressLine1AndAddressLine2)
        left join busc.crm_categories d on d.value = c.City and d.categorytype = 'City' ---> Lookup to get the CITY (CityAndProvince)
        left join busc.crm_categories e on b.state = e.value and e.categorytype = 'State'  ---> Lookup to get the STATE (CityAndProvince)
        left join busc.lns_acctauthsign v on v.cust_id = b.core_cust_id --> Connection to busc.lns_acctauthsign
        left join busc.lns_generalacctmast n on n.acid = v.acid --> connection to busc.lns_generalacctmast to get AccountNumber, AccountType, AccountSolId
        left join busc.dep_casamaster z on z.acid = n.acid --> Connection to get AccountStatus
        left join busc.dep_tdmaster x on x.acid = z.acid --> Connection to get AccountStatus
        left join busc.lns_laacctmast f on f.acid = n.acid --> Connection to get AccountStatus
        where accountid_cust_nbr LIKE 'CBC_CRM%'
        -->isLatest  = 1 (Latest data for busc)
        and b.isLatest = 1
        and c.isLatest = 1
        and d.isLatest = 1
        and e.isLatest = 1
        and v.isLatest = 1
        and n.isLatest = 1
--        and z.isLatest = 1
--        and x.isLatest = 1
--        and f.isLatest = 1


--This SELECT statement contains the AccountNumber of TRU--
 UNION --> Unifying all results of DEP, LNS and TRUs' AccountNumber, AccountType and AccountSolId except duplicates

    select
    [Group],
    BASE_SCORE as BaseScore,
    convert(varchar,b.orgkey) as CifId,
    b.name as CustomerName,
    convert(varchar(20),b.cust_dob,101) as DateOfBirth,
    b.MAIDENNAMEOFMOTHER as MothersMaidenName,
    b.GENERALTAXID as TaxIdentificationNumber,
    concat(c.address_line1, ' ', c.address_line2) as AddressLine1AndAddressLine2,
    concat(d.description , ' ', e.description) as CityAndProvince,
    convert(varchar(20),b.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE,101) as CifCreationDate,
    convert(varchar,k.portfolio_no) as AccountNumber, --> TRU
    NULL as AccountType, 
    NULL as AccountSolid,  
    k.STATUS as AccountStatus,
    convert(varchar(20),k.AUTH_DATE,101) as AccountOpeningDate,
    RIB_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as OnlineBankingIndicator,
    MBK_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as MobileBankingIndicator,
    ATM_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as LinkedCardIndicator
    
    from syn.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults a
        left join busc.crm_accounts b on replace(convert(varchar,a.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR),'CBC_CRM_','') = convert(varchar,b.accountid) ---> To connect busc.crm_accounts to get Orgkey(CifId), Name(CustomerName), Cust_DOB(DateOfBirth), MaidennameOfMother(MothersMaidenName), TIN(TaxIdentificationNumber), Cif Creation Date(CifCreationDate)
        left join busc.crm_address c on b.orgkey = convert(varchar,c.orgkey) ---> Connection to get ADDRESS1 & ADDRESS2 (AddressLine1AndAddressLine2)
        left join busc.crm_categories d on d.value = c.City and d.categorytype = 'City' ---> Lookup to get the CITY (CityAndProvince)
        left join busc.crm_categories e on b.state = e.value and e.categorytype = 'State' ---> Lookup to get the STATE (CityAndProvince)
        left join busc.tru_cust m on m.unique_id = b.ORGKEY --> Connection to busc.tru_cust
        left join busc.tru_baselink l on l.cif_no = m.cust_no  --> Connection to get AccountNumber
        left join busc.tru_portfolio k on k.base_no = l.cust_no --> Connection to get AccountStatus
        where accountid_cust_nbr LIKE 'CBC_CRM%'
        -->isLatest  = 1 (Latest data for busc)
        and b.isLatest = 1
        and c.isLatest = 1
        and d.isLatest = 1
        and e.isLatest = 1
        and m.isLatest = 1
        and l.islatest = 1
        and k.islatest = 1

UNION --> Unifying all results of DEP, LNS,TRU and TRYs' AccountNumber, AccountType and AccountSolId except duplicates


    select
    [Group],
    BASE_SCORE as BaseScore,
    convert(varchar,b.orgkey) as CifId,
    b.name as CustomerName,
    convert(varchar(20),b.cust_dob,101) as DateOfBirth,
    b.MAIDENNAMEOFMOTHER as MothersMaidenName,
    b.GENERALTAXID as TaxIdentificationNumber,
    concat(c.address_line1, ' ', c.address_line2) as AddressLine1AndAddressLine2,
    concat(d.description , ' ', e.description) as CityAndProvince,
    convert(varchar(20),b.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE,101) as CifCreationDate,
    convert(varchar,f.ID) as Accountnumber, -- TRY
    NULL as AccountType, 
    NULL as AccountSolid,
    NULL as AccountStatus,
    NULL as AccountOpeningDate,
    RIB_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as OnlineBankingIndicator,
    MBK_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as MobileBankingIndicator,
    ATM_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as LinkedCardIndicator

    from syn.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults a
        left join busc.crm_accounts b on replace(convert(varchar,a.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR),'CBC_CRM_','') = convert(varchar,b.accountid) ---> To connect busc.crm_accounts to get Orgkey(CifId), Name(CustomerName), Cust_DOB(DateOfBirth), MaidennameOfMother(MothersMaidenName), TIN(TaxIdentificationNumber), Cif Creation Date(CifCreationDate)
        left join busc.crm_address c on b.orgkey = convert(varchar,c.orgkey) ---> Connection to get ADDRESS1 & ADDRESS2 (AddressLine1AndAddressLine2)
        left join busc.crm_categories d on d.value = c.City and d.categorytype = 'City' ---> Lookup to get the CITY (CityAndProvince)
        left join busc.crm_categories e on b.state = e.value and e.categorytype = 'State' ---> Lookup to get the STATE (CityAndProvince)
        left join busc.try_legalentity f on convert(varchar,f.external_ref) = convert(varchar,b.orgkey) --> Connection to get AccountNumber
        where accountid_cust_nbr LIKE 'CBC_CRM%'
        -->isLatest  = 1 (Latest data for busc)
        and b.isLatest = 1
        and c.isLatest = 1
        and d.isLatest = 1
        and e.isLatest = 1
        and f.isLatest = 1
        

UNION --> Unifying all results of DEP, LNS,TRU,TRY and Cards' except duplicates

--This SELECT statement contains the records of Cards Customers--
    select 
    [Group],
    BASE_SCORE as BaseScore,
    convert(varchar,f.cust_nbr) as CifId,
    f.cust_local_name as CustomerName,
    convert(varchar(20),convert(date,cast(f.cust_dte_birth as varchar(20))),101) as DateOfBirth,
    f.cust_mom_name as MothersMaidenName,
    f.cust_tax_id as TaxIdentificationNumber,
    concat(f.cust_addr1 ,' ', f.cust_addr2) as AddressLine1AndAddressLine2,
    concat (f.cust_add_city, ' ', f.cust_add_province),
    NULL as CifCreationDate,
    NULL as AccountNumber,
    NULL as AccountType,
    NULL as AccountSolId,
    NULL as AccountStatus,
    NULL as AccountOpeningDate,
    RIB_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as OnlineBankingIndicator,
    MBK_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as MobileBankingIndicator,
    ATM_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as LinkedCardIndicator

    
    from syn.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults a
        left join busc.ccd_mcustomer f on replace(convert(varchar,a.Accountid_cust_nbr),'CBC_Cards_','') = convert(varchar,f.cust_nbr)
        where accountid_cust_nbr LIKE 'CBC_CARD%'
        and f.isLatest = 1


UNION --> Unifying all results of DEP, LNS,TRU,TRY,Cards and CBsecs' except duplicates


--This SELECT statement contains the records of CBSec Customers--
   select 
   [Group],
    BASE_SCORE as BaseScore,
   convert(varchar,g.cltcode) as CifId,
   g.cname as CustomerName,
   convert(varchar(20),g.BDATE,101) as DateOfBirth,
   g.mother as MothersMaidenName,
   g.tin as TaxIdentificationNumber,
   g.Home_addr1 as AddressLine1AndAddressLine2,
   concat(HOME_ADDR2, ' ', HOME_ADDR3) as CityAndProvince,
   g.DAte_created as CifCreationDate,
   null as AccountNumber,
   null as AccountType,
   null as AccountSolId,
   null as AccountStatus,
   null as AccountOpeningDate,
   RIB_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as OnlineBankingIndicator,
   MBK_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as MobileBankingIndicator,
   ATM_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT as LinkedCardIndicator
   
   from syn.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults a
       left join busc.sec_tblclient g on convert(varchar,REPLACE(SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 39, 5),'_','')) = convert(varchar,g.cltcode)    

)
